about: Registry of design-criteria guardrails. A rule is ACTIVE only if its text was read from a public source or its numbers are supplied by the user from a licensed copy with the clause and edition named. Nothing is filled in from memory. Guardrails report; they never change a simulation result or a published number.

rules.clause: (d)(2)(i)(D) safe upper and lower limits for items such as temperatures, pressures, flows or compositions
rules.how: the case declares safe limits per stream in design_limits.streams (T_C, P_kPa, mass_kg_h, with an anchor); every simulated stream is checked against them in every scenario and package. The regulation sets no numbers: the limits are the process's own.

rules.clause: (d)(2)(i)(E) evaluation of the consequences of deviations; (f)(1)(ii) operating limits: consequences of deviation
rules.how: a case that simulates scenarios (deviations) but declares no safe limits is reported as a coverage gap, because the deviations then have no consequence criterion.

rules.clause: (d)(3)(i)(G) material and energy balances for processes built after May 26, 1992
rules.tolerance_source: tool default, not from the regulation (it sets no number)
rules.how: feed mass equals product mass in the simulated flowsheet.

rules.clause: (a)(19)(i) to (v) categories 1 to 4 by flashpoint and boiling point; liquids heated for use to within 30 F (16.7 C) of their flashpoint are handled as the next more hazardous category
rules.how: needs flashpoint and boiling point per compound in design_limits.compounds (from a safety data sheet, with an anchor); applies to streams that are at least 99.9 % mass one such compound, since a mixture's flashpoint is not available. Reports the category and whether the simulated temperature triggers the heated-near-flashpoint rule: an information status, not a violation.

rules.standard: API Standard 520 / 521 (pressure-relieving systems), ASME BPVC overpressure
rules.clause: allowable accumulation over the set pressure
rules.source: not read: the standards are sold or behind a free-read-only login, which this tool does not bypass
rules.how: ACTIVE ONLY WHEN the case supplies design_limits.relief.<unit> = {set_pressure_kPa, accumulation_pct, anchor naming the clause and edition} from a licensed copy; the stream pressure at that unit is then checked against set pressure x (1 + accumulation/100). No accumulation value is built in.

rules.source: not read: free-access view requires a login, which this tool does not use
rules.how: registered so the gap is visible; no check is implemented until the user supplies clauses and numbers from a licensed copy.
